question: The "piece of Kuuigosu" from chapter 653. I recognize that when you read it backwards, you get "Sugoiuku" → "Floats Unbelievably". (sparkle) Then, I suddenly remembered about the "piece of wood that floats unbelievably" that made devil fruit user Mr. 3 float in the water after being K.O.ed in the Alabasta Arc; could it be that you were talking about this back then?! Well?!
answer: Uh-huh. So you realized? I knew it! In the SBS of volume 25, I gave a blunt explanation of fruit user Mr. 3 floating on water, and yes. What I meant back then was PRECISELY THIS!!Back then you know? You guys all probably thought I said something random only to avoid the moment of silence, right? Uh, wrong. I've already tho.. thought of this scenario from uh.. way back then, hehe... N, no... really! (sweat)
